trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops by itself the moment the other 54 are done, so there is no separate task to plan. Use the tracker here to see what is left, and finish the 100% checklist gold last, since it is the longest grind. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours in a single playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy that cannot be missed. Just play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and finish it; the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is the first story trophy most players will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through every main mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes; it pops right after the last mission of the chapter. Before moving on, do the one missable meditation at Jason's house described under Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish all of Chapter 2's main missions, including Coffee Break, which unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia and opens the partner trophies. It pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Clear Chapter 3's main missions; along the way you unlock the Key Cloner, the Snap Gun, jewelry robberies and Randy's wish list, which feed several later trophies. It pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 4's main missions, including the Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown missions that each carry their own trophy. It pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the final mission, which PowerPyx places at the end of Chapter 4 in Starting From Zero. Once the credits roll you return to free-roam, so everything else can still be cleaned up afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. No side task is needed for it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is one of the big set-piece missions of the chapter.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. The airport setting here is also where Catch Me If You Can is earned later.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and the whole endgame. After the story, the 100% checklist opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion; progress you made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds, closer to 60% true completion: scan any 200 of 277 base vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, finish any 70 of 80 challenges, and do any 100 optional missions. The only parts that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Do side content as it appears and clean up the rest in free-roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. You may mix categories freely, and flying under bridges is the quickest way to build the total. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, and filter the map for Activities to find the blue icons. You will likely tick most of these off naturally while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across 12 range locations. The gold scores are not harsh, so take your time, learn each range's targets, and retry the ones you miss. Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; there are 42 drone races in total, so you only need one win per location. Learn each course's gates first, then race for the win. All of them count toward the 100% checklist too.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Each distinct race only counts once, so keep moving to new locations instead of repeating one you like. A fast car or bike you are comfortable with matters more than the most expensive one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge. If the invite does not appear at once, keep playing the story and check your messages.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it, so pick the one you enjoy most.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: she calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests, from Climbing the Cellerichain through Puff Puff Pass, and the trophy pops at the end. All of her quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. After the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks, marking purple chest icons on the map; use the metal detector on the ocean floor to dig each one up and bring it back. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests, from Thrillbillies through Hometown Heroes, and the trophy pops at the end. All of his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands that the game counts. Not every side questline counts: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing mentor) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). All strangers stay available after the story, and your count shows in the trophy tracker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered; check the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List, scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is wanted, then drive it to his garage in the west of Vice City in good condition for a better payout. It can all be finished after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point you to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City; destroy enough of them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest and Tyrone hands you the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down. Finish it and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double, and you can track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. MISSABLE: one early meditation happens only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. It is not marked as a regular spot, and whether it is required is still unconfirmed, but PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together after Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when he texts you about the quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animal he requests and bring it back to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. A clean single shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more. The questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets from the 18 set locations around Leonida. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: work through one set at a time and keep a checklist of which cards you already hold, since only finished sets count. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app by holding up and R1 at each spot. There are more than 100 in total, split across 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags, so you can pick whichever are closest as you travel. Scan anything new you pass and the total builds up on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them under Progress, Challenges, where each one shows its completion tick. Most will happen naturally while you chase other trophies, and since the 100% checklist needs 70, this one pops along the way. Save the easiest remaining challenges for last and pick them off in a cleanup pass.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Unlocked once you can roam with your partner after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: call them with right on the D-pad plus triangle, build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone on the map. A fast sports bike helps you cut through traffic, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because police struggle to follow on the tracks. It also tends to pop naturally during the Chapter 4 bank vault mission, which always draws a 4-star response.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, bring your partner along and rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time; you must keep the flashing wanted level, not lose it between shops. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items from Ammu-Nation first. The 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 unlock them; loot a few items and the back-room safe in each. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles from the 557 in the game. Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan passing vehicles; you only need to scan them, not drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that drives past. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. You need 200 scanned for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, triggered with L3 plus R3 while aiming. It slows time and drains the purple focus bar, so top it up first with food, drinks or a shower at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch the window. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport. It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield; the easiest is at terminals E3 and E4, where stairs by the bridge lead straight into the plane. Get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport before the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Climb in and shoot at enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies on the map. Enter a store through the back door and use the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, which would trip the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where you tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it with your partner carrying a second bag. After that, pay the fence Yasmani for security-van tips at $10,000 each to find more vaults; there are 8 large bank jobs in total and you need any 5 here, but all 8 for the 100% checklist. Each robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. A single vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing the armored truck you tailed. You can also earn it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black fogged area until the map is fully visible. Do it after you have a plane and some flying practice, and combine it with the stunt and vehicle scanning you are already doing in the air and on the ground.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs; there are 39 operations in total, marked by yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs. You only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar with the view in front of you. That is the whole trophy: one drink, one view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After you get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and steal the specific blue Banshee on display. Hack into it with the Key Cloner, then drive forward straight through the showroom window. Only that blue Banshee counts, a nod to the Banshee from GTA 3, and the pop is slightly delayed after you drive away down the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation you first visit in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and if you miss one you can come back later once the robbery icon respawns, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break lets you switch between them. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then scroll to Strength. Buy a gym membership and always train together: call your partner over and while one character works out, the other trains too, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on the notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, and a small demon face appears on screen whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives, clean escapes and destroying evidence push you toward Professional; limb shots toward Hardened; killing toward Violent; mass killing toward Psycho; and constant excessive violence can lock you into the permanent Irredeemable profile, which makes police far more aggressive, so avoid that. It almost always pops passively while you finish everything else.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store; return to that same store in Little Cuba, Vice City, as Lucia alone once you can play as her from Chapter 2. Aim at the teller just like in the prologue, take the money, then run away on foot until the trophy pops. It only counts if you flee on foot, not in a vehicle, and the pop is delayed until you are far enough away.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, while playing solo. Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns. Follow the path from the car into the woods to find the UFO, approach it, and when it drops the woman it abducted, talk to her, offer to help, and walk back to her car at the roadside to finish the encounter.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are packed together, and keep moving in a straight line so each kick lands. The timer is the only hard part, so pick a busy street and a bike you can steer steadily.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew and unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 total is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 each once they unlock in Chapter 4, so this pops naturally during the robbery grind.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos, rather than clothes or snacks. It counts cumulatively across the whole playthrough, so by the time you have kitted out your weapons and cars you will be most of the way there.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone; buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, are the quickest way to raise the money. The 4 story garages do not count toward this trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Buy garages first, since each one adds parking spots you need to register vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and Register in his garage; later, from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
